sentences.text: 7. The learned counsel for the 2nd respondent/Insurance Company submitted that the Tribunal taking into consideration all the relevant documents has rightly fixed the compensation, which does not require any interference.
Hence, he prayed for dismissal of this appeal.

8. In the instant case, the Injured person was working as a fitter and now he was terminated from the service and the accident was happened in the year 2013, considering the cost of living at that time of accident 2013, this Court is enhanced the amount with regard to attender charges at Rs.20,000/- and also enhanced the loss of income at Rs.72,000/-
In other aspects, the amount awarded by the Tribunal appears to be reasonable.
Therefore, the Compensation award by the Tribunal is reworked as tabulated below:-

In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed in part and the compensation awarded by the Tribunal at Rs.2,54,400/- is hereby enhanced to Rs.3,13,000/- together with interest @ 7.5%
